headline: rellik13 climbs from 29th to 21st on ARC-3, just short of gold, with Lohit Siriki on its roster

sections.text: rellik13 gained 1.42 to 37.97 on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, moving from 29th to 21st. The gold line, the score at the last gold place, stands at 38.20, so the team is just short of it.

ARC Prize named Lohit Siriki third-place qualifying open-source winner of the ARC-AGI-3 Milestone 2 prize on October 1, 2026. The public roster lists his account on rellik13; a roster lists accounts and does not show who did the work. Public standings are provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
